summary: Ran final full verification across the monorepo: prettier clean, svelte-check 0 errors/0 warnings over 5,242 files, check-ui-hooks.mjs passes, and 425 tests green across all packages. Then updated the gizmo-frontend-audit.html artifact (header tally, per-finding status badges, closing summary) and republished it, summarizing that 22 of 24 findings were fixed with composer untouched.
decisions: Reapplied blank-transcript fix with a settle loop that waits for both getTotalSize() and row count to stop moving (8 stable frames, 4s cap), releasing immediately on wheel/touch so it cannot fight the user
Marked Settings and Tree dialogs with role="dialog" aria-modal, moved focus in and restored on close, and made the covered shell inert via a display:contents wrapper to preserve grid layout
Deliberately kept titlebar reachable (not in Tab trap) because it holds the only visible way out of the dialog
Restored focus rings on bare inputs
Memoized highlightCode per (language, source) so finished streaming code blocks stop being re-highlighted
Remapped bare 'p' shortcut (pin folders) to Alt+P in the agent text input so it does not shadow typed letters; updated footer hint accordingly
Replaced orphaned role="listitem" on workspace rows with role="group" plus the workspace name to satisfy ARIA and Svelte lint together
Corrected own report: ProvidersSettings missing element is an empty state, not an error path, and the available font-weight was 650, not 550
Left SessionTreeScreen off the pnpm check over-limit followup list rather than adding to it
